description: This script processes GitHub pull request data, analyzes review and timing metrics, and sends the data to Elasticsearch for visualization and further inspection, specifically for merged PRs in the Zephyr project.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for PR processing options.

methods.name: gendata
methods.description: Generates data in the format suitable for Elasticsearch bulk upload.

methods.name: process_pr
methods.description: Processes a GitHub pull request object to extract metrics and information.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates PR data retrieval and Elasticsearch upload.
